class.name: FellowShallowWater3D
class.brief_description: FellowEngine: GPU shallow-water simulation (rivers, floods, shallow areas) with a rendered water surface.
class.description: Simulates the 2D shallow-water equations on a staggered grid entirely with [RenderingDevice] compute shaders (no CPU readback) and renders the resulting water surface with displacement, normals, foam and screen-space refraction. Colliders and impulses are uploaded as a compact buffer each frame. Every processed frame advances exactly [member substeps] substeps of [member time_step] seconds, which makes the simulation deterministic under [code]--fixed-fps[/code]. Requires the Forward+ or Mobile renderer. GPU time of the simulation and of the surface-generation pass is available through [method get_simulation_gpu_time_ms] and [method get_surface_gpu_time_ms]. See [code]docs/fellow_fluid_architecture.md[/code]. A [FellowWater3D] whose [member FellowWater3D.simulation_path] points here draws the simulated surface as part of a larger body of water (this node's own mesh is then hidden); it reads the surface texture and [method get_flow_texture] (cell-centre velocity and depth). In the editor the simulation steps as in the running game (each step asks for a frame); the 3D editor's toolbar toggle [b]Animate[/b] (the editor setting [code]editors/3d/fellow/animate_nodes[/code]) off holds it (milestone 52).

method.name: add_impulse
method.description: Raises (positive [param depth_change], metres) or lowers the water within [param radius] metres of [param world_position] at the next step: a splash, a wave maker. At most 16 impulses a frame.

method.name: clear_colliders
method.description: Removes every collider set with [method set_collider].

method.name: get_flow_texture
method.description: The cells' velocity and depth (RGBA: velocity x, z, the depth, the surface level), for [member FellowWater3D.simulation_path] and other shaders.

method.name: get_simulation_gpu_time_ms
method.description: The GPU time of the last frame's simulation steps in milliseconds (RenderingDevice timestamps), or -1 before the first.

method.name: get_simulation_vram_bytes
method.description: The video memory of the simulation's textures and buffers.

method.name: get_steps_simulated
method.description: The number of substeps simulated since the start or the last [method reset_simulation].

method.name: get_surface_gpu_time_ms
method.description: The GPU time of the last frame's surface pass (the height, normals and foam drawn from) in milliseconds, or -1.

method.name: get_surface_texture
method.description: The surface the water is drawn from (RGBA: the height, its gradient x and z, the foam).

method.name: get_terrain_texture
method.description: The bed heights (R32F) the simulation runs over: [member terrain_image] at [member resolution], or flat.

method.name: get_water_mesh_instance
method.description: The internal mesh instance that draws the water (hidden while a [FellowWater3D] draws the simulated surface instead).

method.name: reset_simulation
method.description: Starts again: the water at [member initial_water_level] over the bed, at rest, no foam.

method.name: set_collider
method.description: Sets moving collider [param index] (0-15): a sphere of [param radius] metres at [param world_position] moving at [param world_velocity], which the water flows around and is dragged by ([member collider_drag]). Set it every frame for a moving body.

members.member: How much of a collider's velocity the water under it takes each substep (0: none, 1: all of it).
Velocity damping per second (friction with the bed, viscosity): higher calms the water faster.
The simulated area in metres (X, Z), centred on the node.
How fast foam fades, per second.
The gravitational acceleration in metres per second squared: the waves' speed.
How many columns of cells at the domain's -X edge hold the inflow.
River mode when above 0: the surface level (metres, the node's space) held in the first [member inflow_cells] columns at -X, with an open outflow at +X.
The water's velocity in the inflow columns (metres per second, X and Z), with [member inflow_depth] above 0.
The water's level at the start and after [method reset_simulation], in metres in the node's space: cells whose bed is below it start wet.
The water mesh's grid (at most [member resolution]): its vertices per side.
The simulation's cells per side: finer is more detailed and costs more (512²: about 0.21 ms per step on the benchmark's RTX).
Off: the water stays as it is (no steps), still drawn.
Bed heights at or above this (metres) are solid obstacles: walls the water does not enter.
Substeps simulated each frame (0: paused); the simulation is frame-locked, [member time_step] seconds each, so it is deterministic.
The bed's heights in metres (red channel, any size: resized to [member resolution] without filtering, so give it at that size for smooth terrain); none: a flat bed at 0.
The substep's length in seconds (stability needs it short enough for the cells' size and the water's depth).
